gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming whose document governs the work under a contract - as distinct from which standard it invokes (see the specification registry, diggs:RIProgramBasisType/governingStandard). These codes are used for the value of the governingSpecificationSource property of the diggs:Contract object. Options drawn from the state-of-the-practice survey Han et al. (2025) reproduces (RI-DIGGS Technical Report Table 3-1, Figure 3-35).
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Governing Specification Source Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The governing specification is the project owner's or a public agency's own provisions - for example a state transportation agency's special provisions for rigid inclusions. The most common answer in the state-of-the-practice survey (Han et al. 2025).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Owner or agency provisions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The governing specification is the contractor's own submitted specification, rather than one issued by the owner or a public agency.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Contractor specifications

diggs:Definition.gml:description: No formal specification governs the work.
